title: Not just for Tree's
text: Not just for Tree's. Used these for heads on my angels. I make and sell these and these ornaments work perfectly. Would buy again.

product_metadata.title: KI Store Creamy White Christmas Balls 34pcs 1.57-Inch Small Christmas Tree Decoration Ornaments for Xmas Tree Holiday Wreath Garland Decor Ornaments Hooks Included
features: KI Store Christmas Balls. 23 different colors of decorative hanging Ornaments allow you to build your collection quickly and decorate with more possibilities.

Creamy White Christmas Ball Ornaments make great addition to your Christmas and holiday decoration. Perfect for a variegated display of Christmas, party, as hanging ornaments on tree branches, table centerpieces, around banister, above reception at different lengths, etc.

Shatterproof Christmas tree balls are combine the beauty and luster of real glass with the unbreakable practicality of plastic. Ideal for families with kids and pets. Set you free from worrying about them getting hurt and glass shards everywhere.

Plastic decorative hanging ornaments are easy to hanging with string hangers and ornaments hooks included.
